readings.moment: When the temple bell struck nine at dinner, Félix looked at his watch.
At the moment the temple bell struck nine, Félix's watch said twenty minutes to nine.
Félix heard a thump on the floor above him, in the atelier.
Félix heard his uncle's repeater sound ten slow deep notes.
Someone went quickly up the stairs, past the library door.
Someone came quickly down the stairs.
Bastien Girard came into the library.
The temple struck eleven while Félix and Girard were sitting together in the library.

durations: 28 minutes: from Bastien Girard coming into the library at 10:32 until the temple struck eleven (11:00), during which they sat together there.
6 minutes: from someone going quickly up the stairs at 10:15 to someone coming quickly down at 10:21, by Félix's watch (the text does not say these were the same person).
whereabouts: Félix sat down to dinner with the family ("We sat down as usual"), and his uncle made a scene about his watch in front of everyone at dinner.
Félix went up to the library after dinner.
Félix stayed in the library alone.
Félix had a brandy alone in the library.
Félix was alone on the floor below the atelier.
The thump Félix heard was on the floor right above him, in the atelier.
Someone went quickly up the stairs past the library door at 10:15 (by Félix's watch); Félix did not identify this person.
Someone came quickly down at 10:21 (by Félix's watch); Félix did not see who it was, because the library door was shut.
Félix stayed in the library alone until Bastien Girard came in at 10:32 (by Félix's watch).
Félix and Bastien Girard sat together in the library until the temple struck eleven.
